prompt: Vertical 9:16 photograph of an English high street at night, shot from across the road and slightly above. At street level, one shuttered shop doorway is lit hard by a streetlight: a sleeping bag and a few carrier bags, the person inside just a shape. Above the shops rises a tired four-storey hostel, rows of small windows with thin curtains, each glowing faintly cold teal, a vague silhouette behind several of them, families crowded into single rooms. The doorway is the only bright spot; the windows go almost unnoticed. No signs or logos readable. Cheap colour film, coarse grain, sodium and fluorescent light mixing, damp pavement. Thanks.
